H01i.prompt:
REFERENCES: Image 1 is a POSE DIAGRAM - follow its pose and proportions exactly. Image 2 is an earlier version whose drawing style, line art and sleeves are right, but whose pose is WRONG (the little fingers are far too long and thin, like noodles, and the fists are too far apart): copy only its style and sleeves, never its finger shapes. Image 3 (Xiao Ke) and Image 4 (DeepSeek) are the character designs, for colours.
PALETTE: Xiao Ke's hand and sleeve use only warm cream #F0EEE6, pale apricot #F2C6A8, terracotta #D97757 and espresso #3B2620. DeepSeek's hand and sleeve use only warm cream #F0EEE6, pale periwinkle #B8C3F7, DeepSeek blue #4D6BFE and deep navy #1B1F4B. No other colours.
POSE (as in Image 1): a real, everyday pinky promise between two young women. Xiao Ke's hand from the LEFT edge (cream ruffled cuff, laced cream sleeve with espresso cross-lacing), DeepSeek's hand from the RIGHT edge (cream cuff with two navy buttons, navy sleeve). The two fists are CLOSE together, almost touching. Each fist: thumb along the top, three curled fingers below it. The little fingers are SHORT and naturally thick - no longer than the curled fingers - and each one is bent at its joints into a small hook; the two hooks lock tightly together in the small gap between the fists. Compact, relaxed, natural.
LINE ART: thin, even contour lines around both hands and between every finger (espresso on Xiao Ke's hand, deep navy on DeepSeek's).
FINGER COUNT: five per hand - thumb, three curled fingers, one little finger. Nothing extra.
